svg.title: The components
svg.desc: Inside Nextcloud, the unified search calls the search provider of the app, and the administration settings call its settings page. The smart picker finds Paperless documents through the reference provider of the app, which names the search provider, and then calls the search provider as the unified search does. The search provider uses the Paperless client, the file locator and the configuration; the settings page uses the Paperless client and the configuration. The Paperless client reaches /api/documents/ of Paperless-ngx through Nextcloud's HTTP client, the file locator looks into the folders of the users, and the configuration keeps its values in the app configuration and the token in the credentials manager.
